details:
I have a habit of viewing VRChat users with generated impostors shown (Very Poor avatars blocked) on PC, and viewing avatar details of blocked Very Poor avatars. Sometimes this leads to the avatar details page not displaying performance details of the avatar and triggers `Nullable object must have a value.` in the logs, until the Main Menu is closed and the avatar details page is reopened.

There are no issues loading avatars, generated impostors, and no error robots in general, so I am ruling out any network issue. I believe this is a race condition in the client in the avatar details UI, or the avatar details page may be attempting to sometimes display performance stats of generated impostors instead (which will fail).

Frequency: Sometimes (nearly guaranteed to have at least 1 occurrence in every 10-20 users); repeatable over the course of several months and client versions.

Steps to reproduce (semi-consistently):

1. Launch VRChat.

2. In VRChat's Avatars settings, set "Block Poorly Optimized Avatars" to "Poor or below".

3. (Unsure if needed:) Set Maximum Uncompressed Size to 300 MB.

4. Clear the cache, if needed.

5. Make sure the above settings are dialed in, then join an instance with many people (20+) wearing Very Poor avatars - preferably an instance you've not been into previously. You should see their generated impostors instead of Very Poor avatars.

6. Open the Quick Menu, select an user, open their profile in Main Menu, then click their Avatar Details. Their avatar should start downloading. Wait for the download to finish.

7. If the avatar loading succeeds and you see performance details, click to switch to generated impostor view in the bottom right and leave it there. Close the Main Menu.

8. Find another user from the same instance with a Very Poor avatar with a generated impostor, repeat step 6 on that user.

9. You have a small chance to see "Included in client" for download size, a white square with "None" for performance ranking, and all performance stats are in gray without details. The state of the "view impostor" button may still also be in impostor view in the UI, but the avatar details page may display the full avatar instead of the impostor (mismatching state of the impostor view button).

If step 9 fails, repeat steps 8-9 a few dozen times on *different users* until you run into the bug. I have not seen this bug reproduced if you have previously downloaded and shown the avatar from the same user (if the avatar is cached).

Once you have succeeded reproducing the bug, closing the Main Menu and reopening the avatar details for that user's avatar will typically display the avatar details (download size, performance rank, all performance details) correctly for at least the next 5-15 minutes if nothing changes about the avatar the other user wears. That's why it's best to view avatar details of other users you haven't downloaded avatars for, yet.

The attached output logs include `--enable-sdk-log-levels --enable-udon-debug-logging`. The first failed trigger of the bug was attempted at 2026.11.06 01:31:03, and the bug is first triggered successfully at 2026.11.06 01:32:40.

I can provide a reproduction video if needed.
title: Main Menu avatar details sometimes fails to display avatar details of Very Poor avatars while an user is seen wearing a generated impostor/while blocking poorly optimized avatars (possible race condition in the client with a repro, not network related)
